<!doctype html>
<html lang="hi">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#24152b">
<link rel="manifest" href="./manifest.webmanifest">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="./icon-192.png">
<title>Vivah Venus | शादी के हॉल खोजें</title>
<style>
:root{--wine:#751d35;--ink:#2c1920;--muted:#65565a;--paper:#fcf8f2;--line:#e9ddd4;--gold:#eac896}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.55 system-ui,sans-serif}button,input,select{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}a{color:inherit}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #bc7656;outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{width:min(1130px,calc(100% - 40px));margin:auto}header{background:#fffaf5;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}nav{min-height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px}.brand{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;text-decoration:none;font:700 25px Georgia,serif;color:var(--wine)}.mark{background:var(--wine);color:#fff4de;display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;font-size:22px}.btn{border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 16px;font-weight:650;background:var(--wine);color:white}.outline{color:var(--wine);background:white;border-color:var(--line)}.hero{min-height:430px;display:grid;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#291720 1%,#301820cb 42%,#49242c22),var(--photo-0,linear-gradient(120deg,#482031,#9c644b));background-size:cover;background-position:center;color:white}.hero .wrap{padding:52px 0 80px}.kicker{color:var(--gold);font-size:13px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}h1{font-size:clamp(36px,6vw,66px);line-height:1.2;margin:12px 0 15px;max-width:660px}.hero p{margin:0;max-width:490px;color:#fff1e6}.search{position:relative;margin-top:-45px;padding:17px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr auto;align-items:end;gap:12px;background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 12px 35px #3b1f2214}label{display:grid;gap:5px;font-weight:650;font-size:14px}input,select{min-width:0;width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fffdfb;color:var(--ink);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:9px;min-height:46px}.content{padding:40px 0 56px}.heading{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:20px}h2{font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,36px);line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 5px}.muted,#count{color:var(--muted)}.muted{margin:4px 0 0}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}.card{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden}.photo{height:190px;background:var(--venue-photo,linear-gradient(140deg,#a7634d,#563041));background-size:cover;background-position:center;display:flex;align-items:end;padding:14px}.tag{border-radius:30px;background:#fffaf2;color:var(--wine);padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.body{padding:15px}.body h3{margin:0;font:700 23px Georgia,serif}.details{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:13px;padding-top:12px;align-items:center}.price{font-weight:750;color:var(--wine)}.small{font-size:13px;padding:8px 11px}.empty{grid-column:1/-1;background:white;padding:24px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line)}footer{padding:21px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}dialog{width:min(490px,calc(100% - 28px));max-height:90dvh;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px;border-radius:18px;color:var(--ink);background:#fffdf9}dialog::backdrop{background:#27141cbc}.modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:10px}.close{border:1px solid var(--line);background:white;color:var(--wine);border-radius:50%;width:37px;height:37px;font-size:22px;line-height:1;flex:none}.stack{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:16px}.request{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.flash{position:fixed;bottom:15px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--ink);color:white;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:10px;z-index:2;max-width:calc(100% - 24px);width:max-content}.flash:empty{display:none}
@media(max-width:800px){.search{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.hero{min-height:365px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.wrap{width:calc(100% - 28px)}nav{min-height:64px}.brand{font-size:21px}.mark{width:30px;height:30px}.hero .wrap{padding-top:40px}.search label:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}.search>.btn{grid-column:1/-1}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.heading{align-items:start}.photo{height:205px}.content{padding-top:29px}}
:root{--photo-0:url(data:image/webp;base64,);--photo-1:url(data:image/webp;base64,);--photo-2:url(data:image/webp;base64,);--photo-3:url(data:image/webp;base64,)}
.nav-actions,.row-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}.panel{width:min(680px,calc(100% - 28px))}.row-actions{margin-top:8px}.request h3{margin:0}.panel-note{font-size:14px}.panel-form{padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px}.panel-form summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:var(--wine)}@media(max-width:520px){nav{flex-wrap:wrap;padding:9px 0}.nav-actions button{font-size:12px}}

:root{color-scheme:dark;--paper:#1b1221;--ink:#fff2e5;--muted:#d4c1ca;--wine:#edce8e;--line:#725e64;--gold:#f6d996;--surface:#2c1e34}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 3%,#422747,transparent 65%),var(--paper);min-height:100vh}
.sprite{position:absolute}.ico{width:21px;height:21px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}
header{background:#24162bfa;padding:16px 0 14px}.brandbar,.roles{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.brand{font:italic 700 clamp(24px,5vw,37px) Georgia,serif;color:var(--gold)}.brand>.ico{width:35px;height:35px}.brand small{display:block;margin-top:3px;font:500 12px system-ui;color:var(--muted)}
nav.roles{min-height:0;margin-top:15px;padding:5px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;background:#2d1d36}.roles a{flex:1;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 4px;text-decoration:none;border-radius:10px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:650}.roles a[aria-current]{background:linear-gradient(110deg,#bf954c,#efd69b);color:#25182a}.roles .ico{width:17px;height:17px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#bf954c,#efd69b);color:#25182a}.btn.outline{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--line);background:#35253b}.small .ico{width:16px;height:16px}
.hero{min-height:270px;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#1c1221 2%,#26152bd9 45%,#32213c52),var(--photo-0);color:#fff3e8}.hero .wrap{padding:32px 0 64px}.hero h1{color:var(--gold);font-size:clamp(31px,6vw,58px)}
.search,.card,dialog,.empty,.request,.stat,.panel-form{background:var(--surface);border-color:var(--line)}.search{box-shadow:0 14px 36px #150b1d55}.search label{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}.search label .ico{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--gold)}input,select{background:#23182b;color:var(--ink)}input::placeholder{color:#baacbb}
.filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:0 0 18px}.chip{background:#302138;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;padding:7px 13px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}.chip[aria-pressed=true]{background:#284638;color:#eefdf3;border-color:#7fa68b}.chip .ico{width:16px;height:16px}
.photo{position:relative}.favourite{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;border:1px solid #96777b;background:#2c1c33;color:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;width:40px;height:40px;display:grid;place-items:center}.favourite[aria-pressed=true] .ico{fill:currentColor}.tag{background:#49324b;color:#ffe2a4}.meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}.meta .ico{width:16px;height:16px}.close{background:#382640;color:var(--gold)}
.dashboard{padding:25px 0 46px}.dash-title{color:var(--gold);font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,44px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.dash-title .ico{width:29px;height:29px}.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin:14px 0}.stat{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 10px;display:grid;line-height:1.35}.stat strong{font-size:26px;color:var(--gold)}.stat span{font-size:13px}.dashboard h3{color:var(--gold)}#add-listing{justify-self:start}
@media(max-width:520px){.hero{min-height:240px}.brandbar .btn{padding:8px}.brand>.ico{width:24px;height:24px}.roles a{font-size:13px;gap:5px}.search{margin-top:-35px}.dashboard{padding-top:18px}}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg width="0" height="0" class="sprite" aria-hidden="true"><symbol id="i-hall" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 21h18M4 21V9l8-6 8 6v12M9 21v-6a3 3 0 0 1 6 0v6M12 7v2"/></symbol><symbol id="i-user" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="3"/><path d="M5 21v-2a7 7 0 0 1 14 0v2"/></symbol><symbol id="i-shield" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 22s7-3.5 7-10V5l-7-3-7 3v7c0 6.5 7 10 7 10Z"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/></symbol><symbol id="i-pin" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 10c0 5-8 11-8 11S4 15 4 10a8 8 0 1 1 16 0Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.5"/></symbol><symbol id="i-calendar" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M7 3v4m10-4v4M3 10h18m-12 5h3v3"/></symbol><symbol id="i-search" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="6"/><path d="m15 15 5 5"/></symbol><symbol id="i-heart" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 5.5a4.6 4.6 0 0 0-6.5 0L12 7l-1.5-1.5A4.6 4.6 0 0 0 4 12l8 8 8-8a4.6 4.6 0 0 0 0-6.5Z"/></symbol><symbol id="i-list" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="5" y="3" width="14" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M9 8h6m-6 4h6m-6 4h4"/></symbol><symbol id="i-plus" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></symbol></svg><header><div class="wrap brandbar"><a class="brand" href="#customer"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-hall"/></svg><span>Vivah Venus<small>आपकी शादी, आपका हॉल</small></span></a><button id="logout" class="btn outline small" hidden>लॉग आउट</button><button id="requests" hidden class="btn outline small"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-list"/></svg><span>मेरे अनुरोध</span></button></div>
<nav class="wrap roles" aria-label="ऐप के पेज"><a href="#customer" id="customer"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-user"/></svg>ग्राहक</a><a href="#login" id="customer-login">ग्राहक लॉगिन</a><a href="#owner" id="owner"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-hall"/></svg>हॉल मालिक लॉगिन</a></nav></header>
<main><div id="customer-page">
<section class="hero"><div class="wrap"><h1>अपनी शादी के लिए<br>खूबसूरत जगह चुनें</h1><p>शहर, तारीख और मेहमानों की संख्या के आधार पर हॉल देखें और बुकिंग अनुरोध तैयार करें।</p></div></section>
<div class="wrap">
<form class="search" id="search"><label><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-pin"/></svg>शहर या हॉल<input id="query" placeholder="जैसे दिल्ली या जयपुर"></label><label><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-calendar"/></svg>कार्यक्रम की तारीख<input id="date" type="date"></label><label><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-user"/></svg>मेहमान<select id="guests"><option value="">कोई भी संख्या</option><option>100</option><option>200</option><option>300</option><option>500</option><option>1000</option></select></label><button class="btn" type="submit"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-search"/></svg>हॉल खोजें</button></form>
<section class="content" id="venues"><div class="heading"><div><h2>शादी के हॉल</h2><p class="muted">एडमिन से मंज़ूर लिस्टिंग</p></div><span id="count" aria-live="polite"></span></div><div class="filters" id="filters" aria-label="हॉल के प्रकार"></div><div class="grid" id="cards"></div></section>
</div>
</div><section class="wrap dashboard" id="dashboard" hidden></section></main>
<footer><div class="wrap">Vivah Venus</div></footer>
<dialog id="modal"><div class="modal-head"><h2 id="modal-title"></h2><button type="button" id="close" class="close" aria-label="बंद करें">×</button></div><div id="modal-body"></div></dialog>
<div class="flash" id="flash" role="status"></div>
<script>
const byId = id => document.getElementById(id);
const modal = byId("modal");
const money = amount => new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN",{style:"currency",currency:"INR",maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(amount);
const dateText = value => new Intl.DateTimeFormat("hi-IN",{dateStyle:"medium"}).format(new Date(value+"T00:00:00"));
const today = () => new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA",{timeZone:"Asia/Kolkata",year:"numeric",month:"2-digit",day:"2-digit"}).format(new Date());

const labels = {pending:"समीक्षा बाकी",approved:"स्वीकृत",rejected:"अस्वीकृत",new:"नया अनुरोध",accepted:"मालिक ने स्वीकार किया",declined:"मालिक ने अस्वीकार किया"};
const htmlText = value => String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, char => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"})[char]);
let state = {user:null,venues:[],requests:[]};
let ready = false;
const listings = () => state.venues;
async function api(path, data) {
  const response = await fetch(path, data === undefined ? {} : {
    method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(data)
  });
  const result = await response.json();
  if (!response.ok) throw Error(result.error);
  return result;
}
async function refresh() {
  state = await api("/api/state");
  byId("logout").hidden = !state.user;
  byId("customer-login").hidden = Boolean(state.user);
  byId("owner").hidden = Boolean(state.user) && state.user.role !== "owner";
  byId("owner").lastChild.textContent = state.user?.role === "owner" ? "हॉल मालिक" : "हॉल मालिक लॉगिन";
  byId("requests").hidden = state.user?.role !== "customer";
}
const icon = name => `<svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-${name}"/></svg>`;
const favouriteKey = "vivah-venus-favourites-v1";
let favourites = [];
try {
  const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(favouriteKey) || "[]");
  if (Array.isArray(saved)) favourites = saved;
} catch {}
let category = "all";
let searchDate = "";
let searchGuests = "";
let flashTimer;
function notify(message) {
  clearTimeout(flashTimer);
  byId("flash").textContent = message;
  flashTimer = setTimeout(() => { byId("flash").textContent = ""; }, 3600);
}
function render() {
  const query = byId("query").value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const minimum = Number(searchGuests);
  const options = [["all","सभी हॉल"],...new Set(listings().filter(venue => venue.status === "approved").map(venue => venue.type))].map(option => Array.isArray(option) ? option : [option,option]);
  options.push(["favourites","पसंदीदा"]);
  byId("filters").innerHTML = options.map(([value,label]) => `<button type="button" class="chip" data-category="${htmlText(value)}" aria-pressed="${category === value}">${value === "favourites" ? icon("heart") : ""}${htmlText(label)}</button>`).join("");
  const matches = listings().map((venue, index) => ({venue,index})).filter(({venue,index}) =>
    venue.status === "approved" && venue.capacity >= minimum &&
    (category === "all" || category === venue.type || (category === "favourites" && favourites.includes(venue.id))) &&
    [venue.name,venue.city,venue.alias || ""].some(value => value.toLowerCase().includes(query)));
  byId("count").textContent = matches.length+" हॉल";
  byId("cards").innerHTML = matches.map(({venue,index}) => `<article class="card"><div class="photo" style="--venue-photo:var(--photo-${index+1})"><span class="tag">${htmlText(venue.type)}</span><button type="button" class="favourite" data-favourite="${venue.id}" aria-label="पसंदीदा" aria-pressed="${favourites.includes(venue.id)}">${icon("heart")}</button></div><div class="body"><h3>${htmlText(venue.name)}</h3><p class="muted meta">${icon("pin")}${htmlText(venue.city)} · ${icon("user")}${venue.capacity} मेहमान तक</p><div class="details"><span class="price">${money(venue.price)} से</span><button type="button" class="btn outline small" data-venue="${index}">हॉल देखें</button></div></div></article>`).join("") ||
    '<div class="empty">इस खोज में कोई हॉल नहीं मिला। <button class="btn outline small" id="reset" type="button">फ़िल्टर हटाएँ</button></div>';
}
function openModal(title, content, panel = false) {
  modal.classList.toggle("panel", panel);
  byId("modal-title").textContent = title;
  byId("modal-body").innerHTML = content;
  if (!modal.open) modal.showModal();
}
const savedRequests = () => state.requests;
function openVenue(index) {
  const venue = listings()[index];
  if (!venue || venue.status !== "approved") { render(); return; }
  if (!state.user) { location.hash = "login"; return; }
  if (state.user.role !== "customer") { notify("बुकिंग के लिए ग्राहक खाते से लॉगिन करें।"); return; }
  const tomorrowOrLater = searchDate >= today() ? searchDate : "";
  openModal(venue.name,`<p class="muted">${htmlText(venue.city)} · ${venue.capacity} मेहमान तक · ${money(venue.price)} से</p><p>${htmlText(venue.features)}</p><p class="muted">हॉल मालिक आपके अनुरोध की समीक्षा करेंगे।</p>
    <form id="booking" class="stack"><label>आपका नाम<input name="name" autocomplete="name" required maxlength="80"></label><label>कार्यक्रम की तारीख<input type="date" name="date" min="${today()}" value="${tomorrowOrLater}" required></label><label>मेहमानों की संख्या<input type="number" name="guests" min="1" max="${venue.capacity}" value="${searchGuests}" required></label><button class="btn" type="submit">बुकिंग अनुरोध भेजें</button><div id="booking-status" role="status"></div></form>`);
  byId("booking").addEventListener("submit", async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const fields = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    const name = String(fields.get("name")).trim();
    if (!name) {
      byId("booking-status").textContent = "कृपया अपना नाम लिखें।";
      return;
    }
    const entry = {venueId:venue.id,name,date:fields.get("date"),guests:Number(fields.get("guests"))};
    try {
      await api("/api/book",entry);
      await refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      byId("booking-status").textContent = error.message;
      return;
    }
    modal.close();
    notify("बुकिंग अनुरोध भेज दिया गया।");
  });
}
function openRequests() {
  openModal("मेरे अनुरोध", '<div class="stack" id="request-list"></div>');
  const list = byId("request-list");
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = savedRequests();
  } catch {
    list.textContent = "सेव किए गए अनुरोध खोले नहीं जा सके।";
    return;
  }
  if (!entries.length) list.textContent = "अभी कोई अनुरोध सेव नहीं है।";
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "request";
    const title = document.createElement("strong");
    title.textContent = entry.venue;
    const info = document.createElement("div");
    info.textContent = `${entry.name} · ${dateText(entry.date)} · ${entry.guests} मेहमान`;
    const status = document.createElement("span");
    status.className = "tag";
    status.textContent = labels[entry.status || "new"];
    row.append(title,info,status);
    list.append(row);
  }
}
function panelRequests() {
  try { return savedRequests(); } catch { return []; }
}
function panelAction(kind, index, value, label) {
  return `<button type="button" class="btn outline small" data-kind="${kind}" data-index="${index}" data-value="${value}">${label}</button>`;
}
function openPanel(role) {
  const admin = role === "admin";
  const venues = admin ? listings() : listings().filter(venue => venue.owner === state.user.id);
  const requests = panelRequests();
  const listingRows = venues.map((venue,index) => `<article class="request">
    <h3>${htmlText(venue.name)}</h3><div>${htmlText(venue.city)} · ${venue.capacity} मेहमान · ${money(venue.price)}</div>
    <span class="tag">${labels[venue.status]}</span>
    <div class="row-actions">${admin
      ? (venue.status !== "approved" ? panelAction("listing",venue.id,"approved","मंज़ूर करें") : "") +
        (venue.status !== "rejected" ? panelAction("listing",venue.id,"rejected","अस्वीकार करें") : "")
      : panelAction("edit",venue.id,"","बदलें")}</div></article>`).join("");
  const requestRows = requests.map((entry,index) => `<article class="request">
    <h3>${htmlText(entry.venue)}</h3><div>${htmlText(entry.name)} · ${dateText(entry.date)} · ${entry.guests} मेहमान</div>
    <span class="tag">${labels[entry.status || "new"]}</span>
    ${!admin && (!entry.status || entry.status === "new") ? `<div class="row-actions">
      ${panelAction("request",entry.id,"accepted","स्वीकार करें")}${panelAction("request",entry.id,"declined","अस्वीकार करें")}</div>` : ""}
    </article>`).join("");
  const stats = admin
    ? [["स्वीकृत हॉल", venues.filter(venue => venue.status === "approved").length], ["समीक्षा बाकी", venues.filter(venue => venue.status === "pending").length], ["बुकिंग अनुरोध",requests.length]]
    : [["नए अनुरोध",requests.filter(entry => !entry.status || entry.status === "new").length],["स्वीकार किए गए",requests.filter(entry => entry.status === "accepted").length],["मेरी लिस्टिंग",venues.length]];
  byId("dashboard").innerHTML = `
    <h1 class="dash-title">${icon(admin ? "shield" : "hall")}${admin ? "एडमिन पैनल" : "हॉल मालिक पैनल"}</h1>
    <div class="stats">${stats.map(([label,value]) => `<div class="stat"><strong>${value}</strong><span>${label}</span></div>`).join("")}</div>

    <div class="stack" id="panel-content">
    ${admin ? "" : '<button id="add-listing" class="btn" type="button"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-plus"/></svg>नया हॉल जोड़ें</button><div id="listing-editor" hidden></div>'}
    <section><h3>${admin ? "लिस्टिंग की समीक्षा" : "मेरी लिस्टिंग"}</h3><div class="stack">${listingRows}</div></section>
    <section><h3>बुकिंग अनुरोध (${requests.length})</h3><div class="stack">${requestRows || "अभी कोई अनुरोध नहीं है।"}</div></section>
    <div id="panel-status" role="status"></div></div>`;
  if (!admin) byId("add-listing").addEventListener("click", () => editListing());
  byId("panel-content").addEventListener("click", async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest("[data-kind]");
    if (!button) return;
    const {kind,index,value} = button.dataset;
    if (kind === "edit") { editListing(index); return; }
    try {
      await api(kind === "listing" ? "/api/review" : "/api/respond",{id:index,status:value});
      await refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      byId("panel-status").textContent = error.message;
      return;
    }
    render();
    openPanel(role);
    byId("panel-status").textContent = "स्थिति अपडेट हो गई।";
  });
}
function editListing(id) {
  const venue = listings().find(item => item.id === id);
  const editor = byId("listing-editor");
  editor.hidden = false;
  editor.innerHTML = `<form id="listing-form" class="stack panel-form">
    <h3>${venue ? "हॉल की जानकारी बदलें" : "नया हॉल जोड़ें"}</h3>
    <label>हॉल का नाम<input name="name" required maxlength="80"></label>
    <label>शहर<input name="city" required maxlength="60"></label>
    <label>हॉल का प्रकार<input name="type" required maxlength="60"></label>
    <label>अधिकतम मेहमान<input name="capacity" type="number" required min="1" max="100000"></label>
    <label>शुरुआती कीमत (₹)<input name="price" type="number" required min="1" max="1000000000"></label>
    <label>सुविधाएँ<input name="features" required maxlength="200"></label>
    <button class="btn">समीक्षा के लिए सेव करें</button><div role="status" id="editor-status"></div></form>`;
  const form = byId("listing-form");
  if (venue) for (const input of form.querySelectorAll("input")) input.value = venue[input.name];
  form.elements.name.focus();
  form.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const fields = new FormData(form);
    const draft = Object.fromEntries([...fields].map(([key,value]) => [key,value.trim()]));
    if (Object.values(draft).some(value => !value)) {
      byId("editor-status").textContent = "कृपया सभी जानकारी भरें।";
      return;
    }
    try {
      await api("/api/listing",{...draft,id,capacity:Number(draft.capacity),price:Number(draft.price)});
      await refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      byId("editor-status").textContent = error.message;
      return;
    }
    render();
    openPanel("owner");
    byId("panel-status").textContent = "लिस्टिंग समीक्षा के लिए सेव हो गई।";
  });
}
function loginPage(role, register = false) {
  const title = {customer:"ग्राहक",owner:"हॉल मालिक",admin:"एडमिन"}[role];
  const dashboard = byId("dashboard");
  dashboard.innerHTML = `<h1 class="dash-title">${title} ${register ? "रजिस्ट्रेशन" : "लॉगिन"}</h1>
    <form class="stack panel-form" id="login-form">
      <label>ईमेल<input name="email" type="email" autocomplete="username" maxlength="180" required></label>
      <label>पासवर्ड<input name="password" type="password" autocomplete="${register ? "new-password" : "current-password"}" minlength="8" maxlength="128" required></label>
      <button class="btn">${register ? "खाता बनाएँ" : "लॉगिन करें"}</button>
      ${role !== "admin" ? `<button type="button" id="switch-auth" class="btn outline">${register ? "पहले से खाता है? लॉगिन करें" : "नया खाता बनाएँ"}</button>` : ""}
      <div id="auth-status" role="status"></div>
    </form>`;
  byId("switch-auth")?.addEventListener("click",() => loginPage(role,!register));
  byId("login-form").addEventListener("submit",async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const button = form.querySelector('button');
    button.disabled = true;
    const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));
    try {
      await api(register ? "/api/register" : "/api/login",{...data,role});
      await refresh();
      render();
      if (role === "customer") location.hash = "customer";
      showPage();
    } catch (error) {
      if (form.isConnected) byId("auth-status").textContent = error.message;
    } finally { button.disabled = false; }
  });
}
function showPage() {
  if (!ready) return;
  const hash = location.hash.slice(1);
  const role = ["owner","admin","login"].includes(hash) ? hash : "customer";
  for (const name of ["customer","owner"]) {
    if (name === role) byId(name).setAttribute("aria-current","page");
    else byId(name).removeAttribute("aria-current");
  }
  const dashboard = byId("dashboard");
  const privatePage = role !== "customer";
  byId("customer-page").hidden = privatePage;
  dashboard.hidden = !privatePage;
  dashboard.replaceChildren();
  if (role === "login") {
    if (state.user) location.hash = "customer";
    else loginPage("customer");
  } else if (role === "admin" || role === "owner") {
    if (state.user?.role === role) openPanel(role);
    else if (!state.user) loginPage(role);
    else dashboard.textContent = "इस खाते से यह पेज उपलब्ध नहीं है।";
  }
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
byId("logout").addEventListener("click",async () => {
  try { await api("/api/logout",{}); await refresh(); render(); location.hash = "customer"; showPage(); }
  catch (error) { notify(error.message); }
});
window.addEventListener("hashchange",showPage);
byId("filters").addEventListener("click", event => {
  const button = event.target.closest("[data-category]");
  if (!button) return;
  category = button.dataset.category;
  render();
  [...byId("filters").querySelectorAll("button")].find(item => item.dataset.category === category)?.focus();
});
byId("date").min = today();
byId("search").addEventListener("submit", event => {
  event.preventDefault();
  searchDate = byId("date").value;
  searchGuests = byId("guests").value;
  render();
  byId("venues").scrollIntoView({block:"start"});
});
byId("cards").addEventListener("click", event => {
  const button = event.target.closest("button");
  if (!button) return;
  if (button.id === "reset") {
    byId("search").reset();
    searchDate = "";
    searchGuests = "";
    category = "all";
    render();
    byId("query").focus();
    return;
  }
  if (button.hasAttribute("data-favourite")) {
    const index = button.dataset.favourite;
    const next = favourites.includes(index) ? favourites.filter(item => item !== index) : [...favourites,index];
    try { localStorage.setItem(favouriteKey, JSON.stringify(next)); }
    catch { notify("पसंदीदा हॉल सेव नहीं हो सका।"); return; }
    favourites = next;
    render();
    (byId("cards").querySelector(`[data-favourite="${index}"]`) || byId("filters").querySelector('[aria-pressed="true"]'))?.focus();
    return;
  }
  openVenue(Number(button.dataset.venue));
});
byId("requests").addEventListener("click",openRequests);
byId("close").addEventListener("click", () => modal.close());
modal.setAttribute("aria-labelledby","modal-title");
refresh().then(() => { ready = true; render(); showPage(); }).catch(() => notify("ऐप सर्वर से कनेक्ट नहीं हो सका।"));
</script>

</body>
</html>
